explanation: Original T06 test bodies unchanged. Failure classification is an implementation plan, not proof those tests pass with authenticated fixtures.

cases.name: database and JSON schema correspondence matches every business table, field, SQL type, nullability, primary key, relation and unique constraint
database and JSON schema correspondence validates actual DB rows, including all plan versions and task-tag joins, against the contract
database and JSON schema correspondence DB enforces execution foreign keys, active-log uniqueness and completion consistency

T06 phase 1: actual SQLite and API DB itself prevents update and delete of preserved versions
T06 phase 1: actual SQLite and API rejects a stale plan edit without creating another version
